title: Bueller
text: Bueller is an R package for analyzing chronic absenteeism patterns in student data.

title: Bueller
section: Good data analysis should be simple
text:
Good data analysis should be simple
The package provides one main function:

bueller() - Generates HTML reports from your data files

title: Bueller
text:
Workflow
# Load your data
> bueller("data/absence_data.csv", "Springfield Elementary")
Loading data from data/absence_data.csv ...
Running analysis for Springfield Elementary ...
Rendering report...
Report generated successfully: Springfield_Elementary_chronic_absence_report.html

title: Bueller
text:
Features

District-level metrics with state and peer comparisons
School-level analysis with rankings within district

Grade-level breakdowns and year-over-year trends
Subgroup analysis across demographic categories
Hierarchical proportions showing school contributions
